comment: Version naming policy consumed by tools/gen_cann_release.py.
A new CANN version is auto-generatable only when its name matches one
of the kind patterns below (first match wins, in listed order).
Anything unmatched (e.g. historical 8.3.rc2-style names or future
schemes) aborts the generator so the release goes through the manual
release-cann-image skill instead. Extend this file, not the script,
when the community introduces a new naming style.
A version is buildable only when EVERY file below exists on OBS
for every chip of the current matrix and both arches. File names
must match the generated Dockerfiles exactly (tools/template.py
uses the raw cann_chip, so A3 stays uppercase).
missing_statuses are the anonymous-HEAD answers OBS gives for keys
that do not exist; any other non-200 answer counts as UNKNOWN and
aborts instead of silently suppressing a release.
HTTP probe policy. Unknown answers (timeout, connection reset,
5xx) are retried with exponential backoff plus jitter; only when
every attempt stays unknown does the caller fail, so gateway
flakiness never degrades into a silent 'missing'. Concurrency is
deliberately low because OBS resets connections when hit hard
from CI runners; beta directory scans run in batches of the same
size and stop as soon as a complete directory is found.
unknown_budget bounds the damage when the gateway itself is down:
a scan aborts as soon as that many candidate directories answer
unclearly, instead of retrying its way through all 600 candidates
and burning the runner's whole time budget.
